items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Jelly Roll Morton used to call him the can rusher.

ctx.x: Oh, sure. And everybody in the band would drink, you understand what I mean. There was an Italian fella running the Spinning Wheel, and he had a big can, he'd bring us beer in a can, you know, spike it with alcohol. And man, before we'd leave there everybody was high.
Jelly Roll Morton used to call him the can rusher.
Oh, yeah. I can't say this one.
